poll.question: Solar rig down, panels cracked, frame bent. For the first time in twelve days, Dan and Hui Ling are warm, fed, easy together. Start the repair tonight while light holds,

options.label: Work tonight
options.desc: Daylight is survival currency—fix it before dark hits and the cold deepens.

options.label: Rest first
options.desc: This peace is fragile and earned—they need whole strength, not half-spent.

options.label: Prep tonight, work tomorrow
options.desc: Busy hands while light lasts, then rest knowing tomorrow's ready—balance and survival.

in_play.label: Move the van
in_play.desc: They've got supplies and fuel. Maybe it's time to find better shelter.
